title: Zakti Prime
extract:
The Zakti Prime is the Primed variant of the  Zakti, with improvements to radial damage, critical chance, critical multiplier, status chance, explosion radius, and magazine size, and significantly lowered recoil, at some expense to reload speed. Zakti Prime was released alongside  Nezha Prime and  Guandao Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Gas damage.
Darts have a guaranteed  Impact proc on direct hits.
Darts explode in a 3.8 meter area radius after 1 second on impacting a surface or enemy, dealing  Gas damage.
Exploding darts will stagger enemies, making them vulnerable to melee finishers and susceptible to stealth damage multipliers.
Initial hit and explosion apply status separately.
Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
No Damage Falloff.
Can benefit from  Fulmination ( Primed).
Innate two  and one  polarities.
Advantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

High ammo efficiency.

Acquisition

Vaultings
On October 5th, 2022, Zakti Prime, along with  Nezha Prime and  Guandao Prime, entered the Prime Vault and were retired from the reward tables. Any preexisting components or fully-built items will remain as is.
